verdict.rationale: Groq is fundamentally an API product. Its docs cover an OpenAI-compatible REST API (base_url swap), Chat Completions with streaming, a Responses API, tool use, structured outputs, and Batch and service-tier parameters. An official TypeScript SDK wraps the REST API, an llms.txt and markdown docs are served for agents, and community users report hands-on API usage. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
